lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters are distributed in a grid-like configuration. Centroids of these clusters maintain a consistent inter-blob distance along the lateral axis posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, specifically at the centroids of the larger blobs, defining a lattice structure on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features show a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with high-luminance values on the dorsal aspect and localized shadows on the ventral aspect, spanning the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs of irregular size, concentrated primarily towards the posterior and medial regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency distribution of small white spots is concentrated in the post-branchial region, contrasting with the larger, more structured spots on the mid-flank.
